key_terms: The number of replicas that store each partition under a keyspace's placement strategy.
The number of replica responses a read or write requires before the coordinator reports success, such as ONE or QUORUM.
A consistency level that requires a majority of replicas, floor(N / 2) + 1 for replication factor N. With RF 1 it is a single replica.
The condition R + W > N, under which read and write replica sets must intersect. It does not by itself make concurrent updates linearizable.
The node that receives a client request, forwards it to the relevant replicas and applies the requested consistency level.
evidence: Actual native ARM64 Cassandra 5.0.9 CQL and retained-state observations; RF3 outage and table-level SSTable restore have independent acceptance receipts. Commands run only in the copied owned Docker project.
